extraction.name: TravelPlanner
extraction.description: A new planning benchmark that focuses on travel planning, a common real-world planning scenario.
extraction.creator: Jian Xie, Kai Zhang, Jiangjie Chen, Tinghui Zhu, Renze Lou, Yuandong Tian, Yanghua Xiao, Yu Su
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset provides a sandbox environment with around four million data entries crawled from the Internet and 1,225 curated user queries with reference plans.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Data was sourced from Kaggle datasets (Flight Status Prediction, Zomato Restaurants, Airbnb Open Data) and Google APIs (Distance Matrix, Places).
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Original data was modified by adding, deleting, and altering keys and values, such as generating price values based on distance.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Specific fields were included while others were discarded, and some values like price were generated using random factors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Graduate students were invited to manually annotate plans for synthesized queries, ensuring each plan met all constraints.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Authors performed a detailed review of every query and plan to rectify errors and re-calibrated budgets based on human-annotated plans.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The definition of commonsense constraints is based on the authors' consensus and may differ from others' definitions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating language agents in tool-use and complex planning within multiple constraints.

name.evidence: TravelPlanner: A Benchmark for Real-World Planning with Language Agents

description.evidence: we propose TravelPlanner, a new planning benchmark that focuses on travel planning, a common real-world planning scenario.

creator.evidence: Jian Xie, Kai Zhang, Jiangjie Chen, Tinghui Zhu, Renze Lou, Yuandong Tian, Yanghua Xiao, Yu Su

rai:dataCollection.evidence: TravelPlanner provides a rich sandbox environment with around four million data entries crawled from the Internet that can be accessed via six tools. We also meticulously curate 1,225 diverse user queries (along with their reference plans)...

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: around four million data entries crawled from the Internet

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: For FlightSearch, we source original data from the Kaggle Flight Status Prediction dataset... We utilize the Google Distance Matrix API... Our restaurant data is sourced from the Kaggle Zomato Restaurants Dataset... we employ the Google Places API to gather information about attractions... Our accommodation data is obtained from the Kaggle Airbnb Open Data Dataset

rai:dataCollectionTimeframe.evidence: From this dataset, we extract data spanning from 2022-03-01 to 2022-04-01.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: We then modify this data, which includes adding, deleting, and altering certain keys and values to suit our requirements.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: We specifically included fields like “FlightDate”, “DepTime”, “ArrTime”, “ActualElapsedTime”, “Distance”, “OriginCityName”, and “DestCityName” while discarding other values. To incorporate “Price” into our dataset, we generate this value by multiplying the “Distance” by a random factor ranging from 0.2 to 0.5.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: To ensure every query has at least one feasible plan, we invite 20 graduate students to meticulously annotate plans for synthesized queries. One plan is deemed eligible only if it meets all the constraints outlined in our evaluation script...

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: To ensure the quality of each natural language query and its corresponding annotated plan, the authors performed a detailed review of every query and plan, rectifying any errors found.

rai:annotatorDemographics.evidence: we invite 20 graduate students to meticulously annotate plans for synthesized queries.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: we utilize GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) to generate natural language queries... In our experiments, we use GPT-4-Turbo for this extraction process.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: We realize that everyone’s definition of commonsense may be different. Our current evaluation criteria are based on the authors’ consensus, and we encourage additional discussions to enrich our commonsense dimension, aiming for a more thorough evaluation.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: TravelPlanner aims to provide an effective benchmark for complex planning in future research.
